step1.title: 4-Way Swipe Answers

step2.title: Secret Until Both Answer
step2.subtitle: Neither can peek before finishing

sampleReport.myDesc: Feels calm with a clear plan and values structure and routines.
sampleReport.partnerDesc: Goes with the moment and brings warmth and easygoing energy.
sampleReport.chemistrySummary: Your structure and flexibility complement each other beautifully—one sets the course while the other keeps the mood light!
sampleReport.risk1Desc: Differences in tidiness expectations may build quiet frustration around cleaning routines.
sampleReport.risk1Advice: Instead of leaving chores unspoken, clearly divide ownership (e.g., trash vs. kitchen).
sampleReport.risk2Desc: One enjoys going out while the other loves recharging at home, and you respect each other's space well.
sampleReport.risk2Advice: Take turns planning one weekend each month centered around each partner's favorite pace.
sampleReport.nextActionTip: Grab a 15-minute coffee this weekend and each share one thing that made you happy recently.

sampleReflection.warmMessage: Every day you spent answering honestly shows how deeply you cared. Neither of you is to blame—take a breath and be gentle with yourself first.
sampleReflection.goodMemoriesSummary: Your answers around weekends and kindness overlapped often, showing genuine care and good intentions between you.
sampleReflection.cause1Background: One of you felt reassured by frequent check-ins, while the other needed solo time to recharge before opening up.
sampleReflection.cause1Takeaway: In the future, agreeing early on a simple signal like "Busy today, will text tonight" helps both sides feel safe.
sampleReflection.myStrengthForNextLove: Your sincerity in trying to understand differences and your willingness to talk things through are wonderful strengths.
sampleReflection.gentleNextStep: There's no rush to figure everything out today. Rest at your own pace—this experience will guide you toward calmer, kinder love.
